Let me be very clear about what I'm hearing.

**The Truth Beneath the Requests:**

Taylor just told us the PDF export is 8 points, not 5. That means stakeholders are actually requesting 38 points, not 35. And we have 20. Rule two applies here—the system always lies more.

| Story | Points | Rationale |
|-------|--------|-----------|

| Test Automation (Auth-focused) | 5 | Morgan gets coverage where it matters most |
| Email Notifications | 3 | Smallest CEO-demo item, ships real value |

Five points of targeted test automation on the authentication module gives you coverage where the bugs actually live. That's better than 8 points spread thin.

*turns to Jordan*

You get your refactor. But you're pairing with whoever takes the dashboard foundation work—knowledge transfer.
